corroboration.note: 2025 admissions guide, labelled Humanities campus illustration on physical page 6.
Official language-centre building-number overview. Its route arrow is not traced or turned into navigation geometry.

Official university newspaper photo caption identifies the corridor from the main gate toward Student Union (정문에서 학생회관으로 가는 길목). It corroborates that corridor only, not measured geometry or current access.

method: Manual corridor interpretation of visible paved spaces, fitted to the existing schematic building anchors without moving those anchors. Source image regions are pixel rectangles [left,top,right,bottom], not a surveyed coordinate transform. Scene points are illustrative centre lines; line widths are visual styling.
sceneCoordinateOrder: x east, z south in the existing local illustration

paths.label: Inner main-gate corridor toward the gap beside Student Union
paths.visibleEvidence: The white paved approach continues from the labelled main gate along the planted island and beside the east side of Student Union. Only the visible internal corridor is retained.

paths.label: Paved frontage between General Hall / Student Union and the sports terrace
paths.visibleEvidence: The pale frontage in front of General Hall continues west toward the gap beside Mirae Hall; its east end joins the visible paved space in front of Student Union. The sports terrace and its stairs are not interpreted as a level crossing.

paths.label: Visible paved gap toward International Hall and the library
paths.visibleEvidence: The white ground strip is visible in front of International Hall and beside the library. The trace stops in this gap and does not continue behind either building or into the elevated library connection.

paths.label: Paved area on the other side of the entrance island
paths.visibleEvidence: A narrow pale approach is visible west of the planted entrance island and opens toward the already documented Student Union frontage. The schematic branch stops before the gate locator; it does not fill the adjacent green wedge.

paths.label: Lower paved apron outside the sports terrace, toward MCC
paths.visibleEvidence: The illustration shows pale ground outside the gate-facing and lower edges of the raised sports platform. This trace stays outside the field and stops before MCC; it does not cross the terrace or convert its visible stairs into a level route.

paths.label: Central ground-level court between MCC frontage gardens
paths.visibleEvidence: The real university panorama shows a central paved court between the two lower garden groups. This short schematic segment ends before the staircase and remains separate from upper circulation; the illustration provides frontage context only.

paths.label: Short paved frontage beside Administration
paths.visibleEvidence: The pale ground follows the front of the curved Administration facade beside the entrance area. Only this exposed frontage is shown; no continuation behind the building, external road or vehicle access classification is inferred.
